titles:
Untitled Ghost Ranch Landscape
Inaugural Exhibition, 1997, Georgia O'Keeffe Museum (Santa Fe)

description: Horizontal watercolor of New Mexico landscape with trees in front of two small hills in the middle ground, while the foreground is unpainted white paper.  The background is an expansive vista of a tree-dotted mesa and a clear blue sky.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
